# HandKind Construction Co.
> Renovation contractor serving Brantford, Paris and Brant County, Ontario.
> Specialising in kitchens, bathrooms, basements, home additions and ARUs.
> Owner-led, 12+ years, 400+ projects delivered.

## Services
- [Kitchen Renovations Brantford](https://handkindconstruction.ca/pages/kitchen-renovation-brantford.html): Full kitchen renovation — layout, demo, cabinetry, tile, lighting and all trades coordinated. Serving Brantford and Brant County, Ontario.
- [Bathroom Renovations Brantford](https://handkindconstruction.ca/pages/bathroom-renovation-brantford.html): Full gut renovations with Schluter KERDI waterproofing, tiled showers and in-floor radiant heating.
- [Basement Finishing Brantford](https://handkindconstruction.ca/pages/basement-finishing-brantford.html): Framing, insulation, egress windows, bathrooms, built-in cabinetry and SDU/in-law suite conversions.
- [Home Additions & ARUs Brantford](https://handkindconstruction.ca/pages/home-additions-arus-brantford.html): Design, engineering, permits and full construction for additions and accessory residential units.
- [Free Estimate](https://handkindconstruction.ca/pages/estimate.html): Request a free on-site estimate — no obligation, reply within one business day.
